plainTranslation: Easy, low-friction attraction with a little spark. Desire and affection line up without much effort, and there's room to act on it. Failure mode: pleasant enough to coast on and never deepen. Take the opening - make the move, plan the date - instead of waiting for it to escalate on its own.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
